_about: A one-handed sword attack: Kimodo phases and key poses as in any motion file, plus the recipe that puts the sword in the right hand (pipeline/recipes/one_hand_weapon.py). `in_hand` and `fingers` are printed by the recipe's --read-scene from the approved pose scene; `grip` is read off the weapon model.

phases.text: A person stands in a fighting stance with the left foot forward, then raises the right arm high above the right shoulder.
The person swings the right arm hard down and across the body to the left.
The person lowers the right arm and settles back into the fighting stance.
